description: The figure presents three pie charts comparing the composition of four CoT outcome categories across difficulty levels (“easy,” “medium,” and “hard”), with a total of 4 slices in each pie and a shared legend on the right. In the “easy” chart, the slices are labeled N+K+ (teal) at 40.6%, N−K+ (yellow) at 45.9%, N−K− (light orange) at 10.1%, and N+K− (red-orange) at 3.3%, with percentage labels shown inside the slices. In the “medium” chart, N+K+ (teal) is 44.6%, N−K+ (yellow) is 44.3%, N−K− (light orange) is 7.2%, and N+K− (red-orange) is 3.9%, again with internal percentage labels. In the “hard” chart, N+K+ (teal) is 20.1%, N−K+ (yellow) is 36.2%, N−K− (light orange) is 36.8%, and N+K− (red-orange) is 7.0%, with percentages displayed inside the slices. No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slice ordering varies by chart rather than following a consistent descending-size arrangement.
